metaDescription: Probable meta description (two-sentence summary line returned by [a], not confirmed as the meta tag): "Secure funding for distressed assets including property and businesses. Fast, flexible finance solutions for turnaround and recovery situations."
summary: Silver Oak Capital's /distressed-asset-finance/ page presents the firm as a UK/London debt-advisory broker arranging finance for distressed assets, covering both property and businesses, for 'turnaround and recovery situations'. The snippets define distressed assets as those undergoing financial hardship due to the owner's standing (foreclosure, bankruptcy, default, poor management), list common types (foreclosures, bank-mandated sales, part-complete developments, underperforming assets), state that purchasers are often offered a substantial discount, and say the financing process mirrors ordinary asset finance but can be quicker: within days for the right asset and borrower, generally 4-6 weeks. No loan sizes, LTVs, rates, fees or lender names were revealed for this page. Query (c) surfaced no page content at all.
